tooltip.computronics.network_card_3.desc: Tier 3 Ethernet Controller with 64 open ports.
Supports 64 KB Jumbo Frames for high-throughput networks.
tooltip.computronics.packet_sniffer.desc: Promiscuous TAP mode for passive traffic analysis.
Monitors PPS, bandwidth, and filters network frames.
tooltip.computronics.card_boom.desc: Detonates computer case on demand. Handle with caution!
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.chat: Allows robots and drones to speak in chat and whisper to players.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.radar: Equips robots and drones with a 3D entity radar.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.camera: Equips robots and drones with optical distance and raycast scanning.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.winch: Equips drones with a deployable winch cable and grabber hook.
